first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMBs and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. Before committing, verify its effects on qualified revenue, retention, and post-promotion behavior, while comparing the strength and applicability of onboarding and activation evidence. A guarded test limits discounting and customer-quality risk.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified record showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing the current onboarding decline while supporting sustainable downstream value. Activation messaging is also validated but had a smaller retention benefit. Promotional pricing is rejected because its +18% qualified-revenue lift was paired with 30-day retention declining 12%, making it inconsistent with the long-term objective.
